blocks.text: Merry Holidays and a very happy New Year. God has sure been good to us and my prayer is steadfast that He will cover you with many good blessings, protection and pleasant things in the year ahead! I want to personally say we love every one of you and appreciate you standing behind this ministry, you have been a wonderful group! This has been an exceptional year bringing us ever closer to the coming of the Lord as we watch events unfolding on a global scale that has changed the lives of everyone this year. Extreme and important changes will be happening in the next few days and weeks. It is now evident that the financial crisis is much more serious than the public was led to believe. I will speak more on this in the January letter. And now a quote from Neal Frisby.

We witness that every part of the Scriptures were given for a divine purpose and are full of wisdom and knowledge and symbols of truth! Let us start with St. Matt. 2:1, “Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem!” Verse 6 reveals a royal Governor would come forth! Then in verses 9-10 it says, “When they had heard the king, they departed; and lo, ‘the star’, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was! When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.” The significance of the star reveals the Holy Spirit was guiding them to a spiritual king! They were led to the spot of salvation. Today the ‘sign of the star’ is leading us to His final acts of deliverance! God has thrown out His net (bright covering) pulling you into the light of destiny, and by His preordained powers He is going to unite His. Although it will be mysterious the elect will catch it, while the foolish follow the bag of gold “mark” and the pale horse to Babylon. (Editor’s note: The number for gold is 999 fine, the Bible number for the mark is 666. Let the reader use discernment.) – Christ the star out of Jacob shall smite Satan’s forces and catch the bride away! Both classes shall reach their fullness, the saints more of God, the wicked more evil! – “The Lord shows Satan’s end! The very fire in him shall explode, the Lord has prearranged his destruction and judgment, his light shall go out!” – Ezek. 28:13 shows how he was created, and verse 14 shows he was the cherub that covereth; he walked in the midst of the stones of fire! Verse 18 shows his downfall; “therefore I will bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee!” Verse 19, “and never shalt thou be any more.” – “Hear ye that are afar off, now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted, now will I lift up Myself, My people shall see Me dwelling on high! I standeth in the congregation of the mighty and judgeth among the gods! Sing unto God ye kingdoms on the earth, O sing praises unto Him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old, lo He doth send out His voice and that a mighty voice!” “The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills by righteousness. They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure. He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass; as showers that water the earth! Righteousness shall flourish as long as the moon endureth! They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before Him; and His enemies shall lick the dust!” (Ps. Chapter 72)

Excellent and unusual things shall appear for the elect for the end is near! – Capture the heart of God by praising Him, for He is looking unto thee! His glory light is shining over thy place! “Thus saith the Lamb, Lord of his people, yea come sit in the shadow of My royal cloud, rest ye under the prince of fire, King of Host! The Most High, the Regal Angel is among His people, from henceforth I shall do a mighty work before them!” Amen! Amen! Let’s exhort Him for He is going to greatly loom over His elect! The flame that’s before His throne will descend upon the Capstone ministry people for the final call! A new dimension and a new era cometh for us. End quote.

This month I’m releasing two Special Writings, “The Hour of Preparation” as well as “God’s Promises – Health and Prosperity.” Also a new DVD called The Perfect Hiding Place. (See offer below.) – I would like to take this opportunity to thank all of those who have continued to support this ministry this year. We have certainly delivered a vast amount of Brother Frisby’s important prophetic message to new and old partners alike. Jesus will certainly reward your efforts in all that you have done. My prayer is that Jesus will bless you in the coming year with health and prosperity and guide you with His continual wisdom.
